title: Cubature Kalman Filter Based Training of Hybrid Differential Equation Recurrent Neural Network Physiological Dynamic Models
method_summary: Hybrid ODE-NN where a missing ODE is replaced by a neural network; trained via Cubature Kalman Filter (recursive Bayesian state + parameter estimation).
dataset: Retinal blood circulation model (synthetic physiological dynamics).
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Their recursive Bayesian training handles one missing ODE for a single physiological system; phys-GIMIN imputes multimodal PD biomarkers across thousands of patients with graph attention and heteroscedastic sigma, not a single ODE on one system.
verification_note: Author list and DOI corrected 2026-04-19 against PubMed PMID 34891402 (authors were wrong in initial JSONL; correct list is Demirkaya/Imbiriba/Lockwood/Rampersad/Alhajjar/Guidoboni/Danziger/Erdogmus; DOI 10.1109/EMBC46164.2021.9631038). Seed cited Demirkaya 2024 IEEE TBME; only the 2021 EMBC version was located. Year correction retained.

title: Automatic and Structure-Aware Sparsification of Hybrid Neural ODEs
method_summary: Hybrid neural ODE pipeline with domain-informed graph modifications + data-driven regularization to sparsify mechanistic state space while preserving inductive bias.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Sparsifies an existing mechanistic graph under neural-ODE dynamics for glucose; phys-GIMIN instead couples a PD-specific alpha-syn/DaT-loss ODE to a graph-attention imputer and adds heteroscedastic + conformal UQ.

title: Attention-MMVAE for Alzheimer's disease classification with missing modalities on ADNI
method_summary: Multimodal variational autoencoder with attention fusion; imputes missing modality representations for Alzheimer disease diagnosis on ADNI.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Multimodal VAE without physics constraints and without graph attention; phys-GIMIN adds a mechanistic ODE regularizer plus patient-similarity graph on PPMI.
verification_note: Seed-provided; search surfaced adjacent mmVAE/ADNI work but not an ICPR 2024 Dhivyaa paper. Cross-reference to Gao et al. 2021 (TPA-GAN) and Wang 2024 (mmVAE ATN subtypes) is safer.

title: Universal Differential Equations for Scientific Machine Learning
method_summary: Canonical UDE formulation: augments mechanistic ODEs with universal approximator neural networks; presents SciML ecosystem (Julia) for hybrid mechanistic-data-driven modeling.
dataset: Mix of synthetic physics and biology (Lotka-Volterra, epidemiology, PDEs).
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Pure SciML framework with no imputation focus, no multimodal patient graph, no PD application.

title: Physics-informed neural networks: A deep learning framework for solving forward and inverse problems involving nonlinear partial differential equations
method_summary: Canonical PINN: neural network minimizes data loss + PDE/ODE residual loss.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Canonical point-estimate PINN; no uncertainty, no graph, no imputation, no clinical data.

title: How Deep is Your Guess? A Fresh Perspective on Deep Learning for Medical Time-Series Imputation
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
method_summary: Comprehensive architectural/framework analysis of deep EHR imputers; up to 20% performance variation from preprocessing choices.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Pure architectural review; shows no deep imputer integrates clinical priors. Phys-GIMIN fills this by adding mechanistic ODE residual.
verification_note: Seed cites 'Qian 2021 CCAI hybrid NN clinical time series' which could not be verified; substituting closest Qian 2024 JBHI paper.

title: Hybrid^2 Neural ODE Causal Modeling and an Application to Glycemic Response
method_summary: Spectrum of hybrid neural ODEs (latent-parameter dynamics, latent-parameter + state closure, MNODE) composing mechanistic ODE with neural flexibility, preserving causal grounding.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Latent hybridization for glycemic response; lacks multimodal imputation, no graph, no heteroscedastic sigma.
verification_note: Seed cites 'Schmid et al. 2024' for latent hybridization; closest match is Zou/Levine/Fox Hybrid^2 NODE 2024.

title: Conditional Neural ODE for Longitudinal Parkinson's Disease Progression Forecasting
method_summary: CNODE: conditional neural ODE; individualized PD progression forecasting modeling brain morphology; learns patient-specific initial time and progression speed.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Pure data-driven neural ODE on MRI only with no mechanistic prior and no uncertainty; phys-GIMIN ties to alpha-syn/DaT loss ODE and multimodal features.
verification_note: Seed 'de Rooij 2025' is likely this paper (van Rooij is a coauthor).

title: Data-driven modelling of neurodegenerative disease progression: thinking outside the black box
method_summary: Review of interpretable data-driven disease progression models (DPM): event-based models, subtype-and-stage inference, mixed-effects, etc.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Pure review of interpretable DPMs; phys-GIMIN is a specific methodological contribution, not a review; cited as framing.

title: An integrative model of Parkinson's disease treatment including levodopa pharmacokinetics, dopamine kinetics, basal ganglia neurotransmission and motor action throughout disease progression
method_summary: Pure mechanistic levodopa PK + dopamine dynamics + basal-ganglia computational model; disease progression via neuronal loss.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Fully mechanistic (no ML, no UQ, no patient graph). Phys-GIMIN uses this family of ODEs as the physics prior while adding data-driven imputation and uncertainty.

title: Alpha-Synuclein Neurobiology in Parkinson's Disease: A Comprehensive Review of Its Role, Mechanisms, and Therapeutic Perspectives (as stand-in; exact Gupta mechanistic paper not verified)
method_summary: Mechanistic review of alpha-synuclein aggregation dynamics, amyloid-like fibril kinetics and therapeutic targets.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Narrative mechanistic review; phys-GIMIN embeds a Hill/first-order aggregation ODE derived from this family as a soft constraint in an imputer.
verification_note: Seed entry 'Gupta 2025 alpha-syn aggregation' could not be located directly in search; using closest 2025 comprehensive alpha-syn review.

title: Understanding and Mitigating Gradient Pathologies in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
venue: SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 43(5), A3055-A3081
method_summary: Identifies imbalanced back-propagated gradient pathology in PINN composite losses; proposes learning-rate annealing and modified architectures for 50-100x accuracy gains.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: PINN loss-balancing methodology; directly cited by phys-GIMIN for lambda_phys scheduling.

title: On the Pitfalls of Heteroscedastic Uncertainty Estimation with Probabilistic Neural Networks
method_summary: Beta-NLL loss: weights each data point's contribution by beta-exponentiated variance estimate to stabilize heteroscedastic regression; fixes the canonical Gaussian-NLL collapse.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Provides the loss function phys-GIMIN uses for the heteroscedastic sigma head; not domain-specific.

title: Conformalized Physics-Informed Neural Networks
method_summary: Wraps PINN point estimates with split conformal prediction to produce distribution-free prediction intervals with finite-sample guarantees.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: C-PINN applied to forward PDE problems; phys-GIMIN extends the idea to per-feature conformal intervals on multimodal imputed biomarkers under an ODE prior.

title: Current state and open problems in universal differential equations for systems biology
method_summary: Review + empirical analysis of UDE failure modes (stiffness, noise, sparse data); regularization restores inference accuracy + interpretability.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Frames the open problem that phys-GIMIN addresses (noise + sparsity hurt UDE). Cited to motivate the regularization choices.

title: GAIN: Missing Data Imputation using Generative Adversarial Nets
method_summary: Generative adversarial imputation: generator fills missing components, discriminator distinguishes imputed vs observed, hint vector ensures true-distribution recovery.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: No physics, no graph, no UQ, no longitudinal. Canonical baseline that phys-GIMIN must beat.

title: MIWAE: Deep Generative Modelling and Imputation of Incomplete Data Sets
method_summary: Importance-weighted variational autoencoder for training DLVMs with missing-at-random data; Monte Carlo single/multiple imputation.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Pure VAE imputer with MAR assumption; no physics, no graph, no clinical priors.

title: SAITS: Self-Attention-based Imputation for Time Series
method_summary: Pure self-attention time-series imputation via two diagonally-masked self-attention blocks trained with joint imputation + reconstruction loss.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: SOTA attention-only imputer; no physics, no graph across patients, deterministic. Baseline in GIMIN benchmark already.

title: CSDI: Conditional Score-based Diffusion Models for Probabilistic Time Series Imputation
method_summary: Conditional score-based diffusion model for probabilistic imputation; exploits correlations between observed values; 40-65% RMSE reduction over prior probabilistic baselines.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Probabilistic diffusion imputer without physics or patient graph; directly comparable as a probabilistic SOTA baseline phys-GIMIN should beat.

title: Latent Ordinary Differential Equations for Irregularly-Sampled Time Series
method_summary: Latent ODE + ODE-RNN encoder for irregularly-sampled time series; continuous-time hidden state via neural ODE.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Generic latent neural ODE; no mechanistic prior, no multimodal graph, no heteroscedastic UQ.

title: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
method_summary: Canonical neural ODE: parameterize derivative of hidden state by a neural network; adjoint-sensitivity training.
dataset: MNIST, normalizing-flow benchmarks, continuous latent-variable models.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Foundational neural ODE reference; no mechanistic grounding, no clinical focus.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Variational-Recurrent Imputation Network for Clinical Time Series
method_summary: Variational-recurrent imputation + prediction unified model; uses imputation uncertainty to weight downstream risk prediction.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Has UQ but no physics prior or patient graph. Reasonable comparative point for the UQ-weighted imputation idea.

title: Recurrent Neural Networks for Multivariate Time Series with Missing Values
method_summary: GRU-D: GRU with decay mechanism on masking and time interval, exploits informative missingness.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Canonical informative-missingness baseline; no physics, no UQ.

title: BRITS: Bidirectional Recurrent Imputation for Time Series
method_summary: Bidirectional RNN treating missing values as graph variables updated via back-propagation; no assumption on dynamics.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Foundational deterministic imputer; no UQ, no physics. Baseline.

title: LagCNN: A Fast Time Lag-based Convolutional Neural Network for Time Series Forecasting and Imputation
method_summary: CNN-based time-series imputer/forecaster using Time Lag features + FFT frequency-domain cues; architecture specified by Eq. 2-13 in the paper. NOT physics-regularized. NOT a graph neural network.
dataset: Weather benchmark (12.5% mask imputation evaluated); also forecasting benchmarks.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Generic CNN imputation baseline — alongside SAITS / GAIN / MIWAE in the standard DL-imputer zoo. NOT physics-regularized; NOT graph-based; NOT clinical. Suitable as a DL baseline on weather/air-quality benchmarks, NOT as a physics-regularized competitor to phys-GIMIN.
verification_note: CORRECTED 2026-04-19: The DOI 10.1145/3627673.3679672 was previously mis-attributed to a 'Liang 2024 HSPGNN' paper via lit-review agent hallucination. The ACTUAL CIKM 2024 paper at that DOI is LagCNN (Li, Jian, Wan, Geng, Fang, Chen, Gao, Jiang, Zhu). LagCNN is a CNN + Time Lag + FFT time-series imputer — NOT a physics-incorporated GNN. Entry key renamed liang2024hspgnn -> li2024lagcnn; authors/abstract/method/tags corrected. Original 'HSPGNN' framing was wrong. See correction note in novelty_verdict.md and clean_room_verification_protocol.md §4.

title: Physiology-informed regularisation enables training of universal differential equation systems for biological applications
method_summary: Physiology-informed regularisation (non-negativity + area-under-curve penalties) applied to training of Universal Differential Equation (UDE) systems: the unknown ODE term is parameterised by a neural network inside a mechanistic ODE; physiology-informed penalties stabilise training under sparse, noisy data. Validated on Michaelis-Menten simulated data and on the glucose minimal model with real PREDICT UK meal-response data.
dataset: Michaelis-Menten synthetic benchmark + glucose minimal model with real PREDICT UK human meal-response measurements.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: de Rooij holds priority on physiology-informed UDE regularisation in biology; this is the ACTUAL closest methodological prior to phys-GIMIN's lit-prior variant. Gaps vs phys-GIMIN: (a) learns an unknown ODE term via NN for trajectory forecasting; phys-GIMIN imputes missing features with sigma preservation; (b) no multimodal / graph attention / heteroscedastic sigma / MC-dropout / Bayesian posterior propagation; (c) glucose minimal model; not Parkinson's alpha-syn dynamics. phys-GIMIN extends the pattern to multimodal imputation with sigma-preserving posterior integration — axes that remain genuinely novel after acknowledging de Rooij.
verification_note: Added 2026-04-19 (Correction 2). This is the #1 methodological prior for phys-GIMIN's lit-prior variant. Code at https://github.com/Computational-Biology-TUe/ude-regularization is CC-BY / MIT-compatible and can be VENDORED DIRECTLY (no clean-room needed). DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1012198 verified at PLOS Comp Biol. Replaces Liang/HSPGNN as the top-1 competitor in novelty_verdict.md top-3. Note: the previously-cited 'Horvát 2025 npj SBA open problems identifiability' entry was already resolved to Giampiccolo et al. 2024 (DOI 10.1038/s41540-024-00460-3) — that resolution is UNCHANGED by this correction. de Rooij 2025 is a DIFFERENT paper and a DIFFERENT methodological thread (UDE regularization for biology applications, not identifiability audits).

title: ImputeINR: Time Series Imputation via Implicit Neural Representations for Disease Diagnosis with Missing Data
method_summary: Implicit neural representations learn continuous functions over time; robust at extremely high missing ratios.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: INR-based time-series imputer; demonstrates an orthogonal continuous-function approach phys-GIMIN can cite for high-missingness framing.

title: SurvLatent ODE: A Neural ODE based time-to-event model with competing risks for longitudinal data
method_summary: ODE-RNN encoder + competing-risk survival head on irregularly sampled EHR.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Time-to-event neural ODE; no imputation focus but similar continuous-time latent representation.

title: IVP-VAE: Modeling EHR Time Series with Initial Value Problem Solvers
method_summary: Continuous-process EHR model using invertible IVP solver as both encoder and decoder, avoids recurrent computation.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Efficient continuous-time EHR encoder; no mechanistic prior, no graph.

title: A Statistical Approach to Latent Dynamic Modeling with Differential Equations
method_summary: Uses each observation as initial value to generate local ODE solutions in a learned latent space; patient-specific ODE parameters from baseline variables.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Closest methodological cousin in neurodegeneration: individual-level ODE params with latent-space inference. No imputation, no multimodal graph.

title: Generative Modeling of Clinical Time Series via Latent Stochastic Differential Equations
method_summary: Latent neural SDE framework with modality-dependent emission; variational inference; handles irregular sampling and stochasticity.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Adds stochasticity via latent-SDE; no explicit mechanistic ODE from domain physics, no patient graph.

title: COPER: Continuous Patient State Perceiver
method_summary: Perceiver + neural ODE for continuous patient state representation with irregular inputs; outputs also continuous.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Neural ODE with multi-modal Perceiver; no physics prior, no graph.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Attention Recurrent Neural Network for Heterogeneous Time Series Imputation (DEARI)
method_summary: Self-attention recurrent imputer with Bayesian marginalization to yield stochastic uncertainty; self-supervised metric learning boost.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Uncertainty-aware imputation without physics or patient graph; comparable baseline for UQ.

title: Generative Neural Networks for Data Imputation in Longitudinal Epidemiological Studies
method_summary: VAE-based generative imputer for irregular long-period longitudinal epidemiology data with missing time steps.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Closest longitudinal-epidemiology imputer baseline; no physics or graph.

title: A Stochastic Multivariate Irregularly Sampled Time Series Imputation Method for Electronic Health Records
method_summary: GRU + neural ODE + Bayesian estimation for EHR imputation, captures time intervals.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Closest EHR-imputation + neural ODE + Bayesian baseline without explicit mechanistic physics or patient graph.

title: Systems Biology: Identifiability analysis and parameter identification via systems-biology informed neural networks (SBINN)
method_summary: PINN specialization for systems-biology ODEs; identifiability analysis + parameter identification under noisy/sparse observations.
dataset: Synthetic systems-biology ODEs + clinical kinetics example.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: SBINN does parameter ID on a known ODE; phys-GIMIN instead uses the ODE as a soft regularizer on latent imputed trajectories.

title: Systems biology informed deep learning for inferring parameters and hidden dynamics
method_summary: First-class SBINN: PINN applied to systems biology ODEs for kinetic parameter inference from noisy/sparse measurements.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Foundational SBINN methodology cited as inspiration; no imputation, no multimodal data.

title: Physics-informed neural networks for modeling physiological time series for cuffless blood pressure estimation
method_summary: PINN with Taylor-approximation of cardiovascular dynamics incorporated into training loss for cuffless BP estimation; 15x data efficiency.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Canonical PINN on physiological time series; cardiology not PD; no imputation, no UQ.

title: Temporally Detailed Hypergraph Neural ODEs for Type 2 Diabetes Progression Modeling (TD-HNODE)
method_summary: Temporally detailed hypergraph of progression trajectories; continuous-time dynamics via neural ODE over learnable Laplacian.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Very close architectural cousin: hypergraph + neural ODE for chronic disease progression. Key gap: no mechanistic ODE prior, no imputation focus, T2D not PD.

title: TrajSurv: Learning Continuous Latent Trajectories from Electronic Health Records for Trustworthy Survival Prediction
method_summary: Neural controlled differential equation for continuous latent trajectories + time-aware contrastive alignment; interpretable survival.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: NCDE + interpretability for survival; no imputation or mechanistic prior.

title: What Uncertainties Do We Need in Bayesian Deep Learning for Computer Vision?
method_summary: Bayesian deep-learning framework combining input-dependent aleatoric + epistemic uncertainty; canonical heteroscedastic-regression loss.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Defines the aleatoric/epistemic taxonomy phys-GIMIN uses; no clinical or physics focus.

title: A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification
method_summary: Reference monograph on split/cross conformal prediction; distribution-free coverage guarantees.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Provides the conformal-wrapper theoretical foundation phys-GIMIN extends to imputation outputs under an ODE prior.

title: Task-Induced Pyramid and Attention GAN for Multimodal Brain Image Imputation and Classification in Alzheimer's Disease
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
method_summary: Attention GAN imputes missing PET from MRI; downstream AD classification.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Multimodal brain-image imputation for AD; no physics, no UQ, imputing images not scalar biomarkers.

title: Personalized progression modelling and prediction in Parkinson's disease with a novel multi-modal graph approach
method_summary: Multi-modal graph approach for personalized PD progression; patient-similarity graph with learned edge weights.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Closest PPMI graph-based progression model; no physics, no imputation focus, no UQ.

title: Prognostic Modeling of Parkinson's Disease Progression Using Early Longitudinal Patterns of Change
venue: Lancet Neurology / Mov Disord (PPMI cohort analysis)
method_summary: Mixed-effects progression models on PPMI; early longitudinal change as prognostic feature.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Classical mixed-effects PD progression; clinical anchor showing the baseline PPMI literature.

title: Deep Imputation of Missing Values in Time Series Health Data: A Review with Benchmarking
method_summary: Benchmark of SOTA deep imputation on 5 health time-series datasets under varying missing rates/types.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: No single method dominates; motivates the need for domain-informed priors like phys-GIMIN.

title: PyPOTS: A Python Toolkit for Machine Learning on Partially-Observed Time Series
method_summary: Reference Python toolkit consolidating SOTA time-series imputation and forecasting models.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Reference toolkit used as baseline harness; not itself a method.

title: Simulation Intelligence: Towards a New Generation of Scientific Methods
method_summary: Position paper articulating 9 motifs of simulation intelligence including UDEs, surrogate modeling, simulation-based inference.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Frames phys-GIMIN as a digital-twin / simulation-intelligence instance.

title: TSI-Bench: Benchmarking Time Series Imputation
method_summary: ~35,000-experiment benchmark of 28 imputation methods across 3 missing patterns, various rates, 8 datasets.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Provides the most recent benchmarking framework phys-GIMIN should target.

title: HyperImpute: Generalized Iterative Imputation with Automatic Model Selection
method_summary: Generalized iterative imputation combining automatic model selection with a MICE-style framework; ships GAIN/MIWAE baselines used by phys-GIMIN's benchmark.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Library/benchmark enabling the GIMIN comparison with GAIN/MIWAE; no physics.

title: Robust parameter estimation and identifiability analysis with hybrid neural ordinary differential equations in computational biology
method_summary: Embeds partially known mechanistic ODE into a hybrid neural ODE where unknown components are approximated by neural networks; treats biological parameters as hyperparameters for global search; performs post-hoc identifiability analysis on three in-silico test cases with noisy data and limited observability.
dataset: Three synthetic systems-biology benchmarks (noisy, partially observed).
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Identifiability framework for hybrid NODE on synthetic systems-biology benchmarks; no multimodal imputation, no patient graph, no heteroscedastic sigma, no PD cohort. Phys-GIMIN's tautology audit is the real-cohort empirical complement to their synthetic-only analysis.
verification_note: Added 2026-04-19 to resolve Task E2.1 concern. This paper was cited 8x across novelty_verdict.md, venue_fit.md, and scholar_eval_report.md as 'Horvát 2025'. Verified via PMC12398592 / nature.com DOI 10.1038/s41540-024-00460-3: the actual authors are Giampiccolo/Reali/Fochesato/Iacca/Marchetti (Italy/CoSBi), 2024 not 2025. No 'Horvát 2025' paper on identifiability of hybrid models in npj SBA is locatable; the lit-review seed conflated the Philipps 2025 UDE review with this Giampiccolo 2024 companion identifiability paper. Downstream files retain 'Horvát 2025' wording; recommend renaming to 'Giampiccolo 2024' in next scoping revision.

title: Accelerating virtual patient generation with a Bayesian optimization and machine learning surrogate model
method_summary: Hybrid QSP + machine-learning surrogate model with Bayesian optimization for virtual patient generation; achieves 27.5% QSP acceptance rate vs 2.5% with random search (10x efficiency gain).
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Closest CPT:PSP precedent for hybrid mechanistic-ML work; focus is virtual-patient generation (sampling from a QSP model) not multimodal imputation of missing biomarkers; no patient graph, no heteroscedastic sigma, no conformal wrapper. Establishes that CPT:PSP reviewers accept hybrid mechanistic-ML methodology.
verification_note: Added 2026-04-19 to back the load-bearing CPT:PSP precedent claim in venue_fit.md §#2. Verified via PMID 39630593 / DOI 10.1002/psp4.13288.

title: Evaluation of machine learning methods for covariate data imputation in pharmacometrics
method_summary: Compares four statistical methods (listwise deletion, mean, Norm multiple imputation, predictive mean matching) and two ML methods (random forest, artificial neural network) for imputing missing covariate data in pharmacometric modeling; PMM + RF + ANN give least biased imputation in the tested scenarios.
dataset: Simulated pharmacokinetic covariate datasets with induced missingness.
gap_vs_phys_gimin: Demonstrates ML-based imputation is accepted in CPT:PSP but uses tabular covariates, no graph, no mechanistic ODE regularizer, no heteroscedastic or conformal UQ. Provides the imputation-at-CPT:PSP precedent for venue fit.
verification_note: Added 2026-04-19 to back the load-bearing CPT:PSP precedent claim in venue_fit.md §#2 ('ML imputation for PK covariates'). Verified via PMID 36346135 / DOI 10.1002/psp4.12874.
